user.title: HA Irrigation Controller
user.description: Pick the pump and sensors this controller drives, then set the cycle start times. Zones are added afterwards.

data_description.pump_switch: The switch that powers the pump feeding your valves.
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting accumulated precipitation in millimetres. Required: watering is modulated by rainfall.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version.
data_description.morning_enabled: Off by default: in spring the evening cycle alone is usually enough. The evening cycle always runs.
data_description.morning_start: Local time the morning cycle starts, when it is enabled.
data_description.evening_start: Local time the evening cycle starts.

error.start_times_conflict: The morning and evening cycles cannot start at the same time. Change one of them, or turn the morning cycle off.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one irrigation controller can be configured.
abort.unsupported_ha_version: HA Irrigation Controller requires Home Assistant {required} or newer; this instance runs {running}. Please update Home Assistant first.

user.title: Add zone
user.description: Model one physical irrigation zone: the valve that feeds it, how long it waters per cycle, and how rain affects it.

data_description.name: How this zone appears everywhere: its device, the dashboard card, notifications.
data_description.valve_switch: The switch that opens this zone's valve. Each zone needs its own valve — not the pump switch.
data_description.morning_duration: Minutes this zone waters during the morning cycle.
data_description.evening_duration: Minutes this zone waters during the evening cycle.
data_description.rain_exposed: On for zones that receive rainfall. Sheltered zones (greenhouse, covered beds) are never rain-reduced.
data_description.rain_factor: Minutes of watering credited per millimetre of rain, applied only to rain-exposed zones. 0 disables the reduction. The default of 1 min/mm is deliberately conservative — tune it across the season.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure zone
reconfigure.description: Changes apply immediately — Home Assistant does not need to be restarted.

data_description.name: How this zone appears everywhere: its device, the dashboard card, notifications.
data_description.valve_switch: The switch that opens this zone's valve. Each zone needs its own valve — not the pump switch.
data_description.morning_duration: Minutes this zone waters during the morning cycle.
data_description.evening_duration: Minutes this zone waters during the evening cycle.
data_description.rain_exposed: On for zones that receive rainfall. Sheltered zones (greenhouse, covered beds) are never rain-reduced.
data_description.rain_factor: Minutes of watering credited per millimetre of rain, applied only to rain-exposed zones. 0 disables the reduction. The default of 1 min/mm is deliberately conservative — tune it across the season.

error.valve_is_pump: This is the pump switch, not a zone valve. Pick the switch that opens this zone's own valve.
error.valve_already_configured: Another zone already uses this valve. Each zone needs its own valve switch.
error.valve_not_found: That valve no longer exists. Pick a switch that is currently available.
error.name_required: Give this zone a name. It is how the zone appears on its device, the dashboard card and in notifications.
error.name_already_configured: Another zone already has this name. Pick a name that tells the two apart.
error.cycles_overlap: With this duration the morning cycle would still be watering when the evening cycle starts. Shorten a zone or move the start times apart.
error.evening_cycle_overlap: With this duration the evening cycle would still be watering when the morning cycle starts. Shorten a zone or move the start times apart.

abort.zone_not_found: This zone no longer exists — it was deleted while you were editing it.

init.title: HA Irrigation Controller
init.description: Changes apply immediately — Home Assistant does not need to be restarted.

data_description.pump_switch: The switch that powers the pump feeding your valves.
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting accumulated precipitation in millimetres. Required: watering is modulated by rainfall.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version. Empty the field to remove it.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Stored for future weather coefficients; it is not used in this version. Empty the field to remove it.
data_description.morning_enabled: Off by default: in spring the evening cycle alone is usually enough. The evening cycle always runs.
data_description.morning_start: Local time the morning cycle starts, when it is enabled.

error.start_times_conflict: The morning and evening cycles cannot start at the same time. Change one of them, or turn the morning cycle off.
error.pump_is_zone_valve: This switch is already used as a zone's valve. Pick the switch that powers the pump, not one that opens a valve.
error.cycles_overlap: With these start times the morning cycle would still be watering when the evening cycle starts. Move the start times apart or shorten the zones.
error.evening_cycle_overlap: With these start times the evening cycle would still be watering when the morning cycle starts. Move the start times apart or shorten the zones.

invalid_stored_config.message: The stored configuration is invalid and the schedule cannot be built from it: {detail}. Fix the reported field (or remove and re-add the zone) and reload the integration.
